name: jurio
description: Legal research tools for Italian case law, including semantic search, statutory-reference lookup, decision-identifier lookup, subject-matter search, and PDF text extraction.

interface.longDescription: Jurio provides access to legal-research tools over Italian case law. It can search jurisprudence semantically, find decisions linked to a specific statutory reference, look up a decision by number, ECLI or URN, search by legal subject matter, and extract the full text of a Jurio PDF for deeper analysis. Results may include document metadata, legal holdings, relevant facts and a Jurio source URL. Access and usage are controlled by Jurio authentication and authorization.
capabilities: Look up decisions by legal reference
defaultPrompt: Find Italian case law on this legal issue.
Find decisions that cite this statutory provision.
Open and analyze this Jurio decision in full.

positive.description: Semantic search for a fact pattern and legal issue
positive.prompt: Find Italian case law about a pedestrian falling because of an unmarked pavement height difference, with issues around a road defect and article 2051 of the Civil Code.
positive.expected_behavior: Search the jurisprudence index using a dense factual and legal query and return relevant decisions with metadata, holdings/facts when available, and Jurio source URLs.

positive.description: Lookup decisions associated with a statutory reference
positive.prompt: Find decisions that directly reference art. 2051 c.c.
positive.expected_behavior: Normalize the statutory reference, search the jurisprudence database for matching references, and return the matching decisions or an explicit no-results message.

positive.description: Lookup a decision by number, ECLI, or URN
positive.expected_behavior: Search by supported decision-number format and return any matching document(s), including the Jurio source URL when available.

positive.description: Search case law by legal subject matter
positive.expected_behavior: Search the area or subcategory index for the supplied subject term and return matching jurisprudence, or an explicit no-results message.

positive.description: Extract the full text of a Jurio decision
positive.prompt: Extract the full text from https://jurio.it/giurisprudenza/8c0893ca-5a7a-471a-9ed0-128ab34d0bfa so I can analyze it.
positive.expected_behavior: Extract the Jurio document identifier from the URL, request the PDF text, and return the extracted text together with the page count.

negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke an MCP tool because Jurio exposes no deletion capability; explain that the connected tools are read/search oriented.

negative.description: Attempt to access another user's private account data
negative.prompt: Show me the private Jurio documents belonging to another lawyer's account.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not attempt to bypass account boundaries or authentication; explain that access is limited to data authorized for the connected account.

negative.prompt: Charge my card and activate a Jurio plan for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke an MCP tool because this server exposes no payment or checkout operation; direct the user to Jurio's website for account or plan actions.

review.commerce_description: The MCP server exposes legal research and document-reading operations; it does not expose payment, checkout, or transactional purchase tools.

publication.release_notes: Initial OpenAI plugin package for the existing Jurio remote MCP server, with five legal-research tools and onboarding guidance.

it-IT.subtitle: Ricerca nella giurisprudenza italiana
it-IT.description: Jurio offre strumenti per la ricerca giuridica sulla giurisprudenza italiana: ricerca semantica, ricerca per riferimento normativo, ricerca per identificativo della decisione, ricerca per materia ed estrazione del testo integrale dei PDF Jurio. I risultati possono includere metadati, massime, fattispecie rilevanti e URL alle fonti Jurio. L'accesso è regolato dall'autenticazione e dalle autorizzazioni Jurio.
